description:
This delightful family home sits on approximately 0.66 acres in a peaceful rural setting just outside Kilmore, approx 20 km from Wexford. The accommodation includes an entrance porch leading into a cosy sitting room, along with a well-proportioned kitchen and dining area. An attached utility room provides convenient access to the rear garden. The property also offers three generously sized double bedrooms and a main bathroom, making it an ideal choice for families, downsizers, or those seeking a tranquil coastal retreat. Externally, the home benefits from a stone driveway with ample parking, while the beautifully mature rear garden enjoys a sun-filled south-westerly aspect, creating a wonderful space for outdoor dining, gardening, or simply relaxing in privacy.
The location is particularly appealing, with the stunning coastline close by. Ballyhealy Beach and Seaview Beach are both less than 6 km away, and the charming seaside village of Kilmore Quay is within 4 km. Scenic walking routes can be enjoyed at Tacumshane Lake and Our Lady’s Island Lake, both only a short drive from the property. A wide range of amenities including shops, schools, churches, supermarkets, a pharmacy, post office, and several popular restaurants—are available in the nearby villages of Kilmore, Bridgetown, and Kilmore Quay. For those travelling or commuting, Rosslare Europort is approximately 20km away, offering ferry links to the UK and mainland Europe. The property also enjoys convenient access to the N25 and M11, providing straightforward routes to Dublin and Cork.
